_comment: PHASE FIVE-K.1 -- implements the frozen FIVE-K.0B §12-15/§42 canonical FIVE_K master contract exactly as governed, for the restricted V1 matrix Intermediate x {4D,5D} only. coreCycle 8/10/13 (§12, EVIDENCE_INFORMED_PRODUCT_DEFAULT). Phase table (§13) read directly from FIVE-K.0B, not inferred: Foundation 1/2/5, Build 3/4/4, RaceSpecific 3/3/3, Taper 1/1/1. compressionPriority/extensionPriority ordering (Foundation=1,Build=2,RaceSpecific=3,Taper=4 for both) mechanically reproduces FIVE-K.0B §14-15's frozen compression order (Foundation-first down to floor, then Build, RaceSpecific floor never reached in-range, Taper never) and extension policy (Foundation absorbs 100% of weeks above Preferred) through this repository's existing, already-proven generic CatalogPhaseAllocationResolver mechanism (confirmed by direct read: phase allocation is driven entirely by catalog-declared minimumWeeks/preferredWeeks/maximumWeeks/compressionPriority/extensionPriority fields, no new C# logic required) -- never a new distance-specific allocation algorithm. Build/RaceSpecific/Taper each have maximumWeeks==preferredWeeks (no extension headroom), so 100% of extension above Preferred=10 is structurally forced onto Foundation alone, exactly as FIVE-K.0B §15 requires.
